name: Opal Plugins
description: Source endpoints for Opal. The app holds the connector code; these supply the URLs and enable the source. Install writes ~/.config/opal/plugins/sources/<id>.json. Torrent ids match the nova2 engine that runs them; stremio entries add a Stremio add-on (one URL, many sources). Two optional endpoint fields apply to any source: "mirrors" (a list, or a comma-separated string, of alternate origins tried in order when "base" is unreachable/blocked) and, for torznab, "path" (the endpoint template, "{indexer}" substituted).
